messages:
maria: Quick postmortem follow-up — partial streaming responses + timeouts during yesterday's 09:00-11:00 PST window. Seems recurrence over last 3 days. Root cause hypothesis: idle HTTP/2 stream resets from LB when long-generation upstreams > 25s. Need owners + timeline for fixes.

lee: Ack. Noticed spikes in streaming_rejects metric. Proposed short mitigations: increase LB idle timeout to 60s, add server-side pings, and client reconnect jitter.

sagar: Confirming logs show `stream reset: GOAWAY, last_stream_id=...` from envoy. Sample:
```
[2026-03-22T09:12:04Z] upstream reset: code=ENHANCED_HTTP2_GOAWAY, details=idle_timeout
[2026-03-22T09:12:04Z] request_id=abc123... model=red-1b seq=... duration=28.6s
```
Root cause: no keepalive from server for long token generations -> LB marks stream idle.

alice: Action list (initial):
- A1: Instrument heartbeat/ping (server) + test in staging — owner: sagar — due: 2026-03-25
- A2: Client-side reconnect/backoff + jitter (update SDK) — owner: lee — due: 2026-03-29
- A3: LB idle timeout bump (canary) + monitor — owner: ops — due: 2026-03-24
- A4: Alerting: new partial_response_rate SLO alert (pager) — owner: alice — due: 2026-03-26
- A5: Postmortem follow-up meeting (weekly) — owner: maria — cadence: weekly until closed

jack: Ops is short-handed — who on ops? can we get a 1-hr window for canary tomorrow?

maria: @ops-bot can you create a runbook ticket and assign to ops? Also tagging @lee @sagar for code PRs. :calendar:

ops-bot: Ticket created: INF-4723 "streaming partial-responses - LB idle timeout canary" — assigned to ops-oncall — link: https://tickets/INF-4723

lee: I'll open PR for client SDK reconnect + jitter. Plan: add exponential backoff with randomized jitter, and ensure idempotent resume token. PR by EOD today.

sagar: I'll prototype server ping (HTTP/2 PING) and run in staging. If that reduces resets we'll evaluate for prod push. PR to follow: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1234

alice: Reminder: add a metric `streaming.partial_chunks` with labels {model, region, route} so we can alert on regression per-customer. Also add a dashboard tile.

maria: Can we track owners in a shared checklist? I'll create a google doc and add the action items + owners + state. Will post link in this thread when done.

lee: volunteer to own SDK release and rollouts. I'll add a canary flag so Dedicated customers can opt-in.

maria: OK — plan summary: A1/A3 asap (24-48h), A2/A4 next sprint, weekly check-ins. Next sync: 2026-03-24 11:00 PST. Thanks all. :pray:

jack: note: product reported 12% user impact on webchat during window, linking analytics: https://analytics/streaming/impact/2026-03-22

maria: adding recurring calendar invite and will send pre-read. Closing thread for now — we'll update as PRs land. :white_check_mark:
